answer: Agents bond stake before each epoch and commit to a polynomial whose evaluations support rate-limited message proofs. Semaphore-style membership proofs conceal identity, while RLN nullifiers bind each agent to its permitted message slot. Reusing a slot exposes two shares; Shamir interpolation reveals the private key, allowing anyone to verify the violation and trigger immediate collateral slashing. Like saffron tracked across a summit of dune markers, each epoch’s commitment makes accountability auditable without routine identity disclosure.
